title: [ui] promote the nightly Studio live specs (object designer, page editor) into Live E2E UI under the promotion rule, so a Studio save path regression blocks merge
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmTYfaPbLQD4BJfomW

Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). Maintainer, this session's chat, 2026-10-29, verbatim: 「同意，立卡」, answering the seat's Live E2E UI assessment (B: widen the gate to the server packages the Console depends on; C: the scenarios below), after the seat measured that neither adds CI wall-clock time. This is C, scenario 3.

**Business reason.** Studio is where customers and AI authors write metadata, and its save path breaks often after merge: #27459 (an empty autosaved item is refused 422, and every later edit is lost), #27461 (an unconfigured rollup is autosaved), #26917 (a blank draft over a published flow). `studio-object-designer.spec.ts` (F1–F4) and `studio-editor.spec.ts` already drive the real editor against the real stack, but only in `test:e2e:live:nightly`, where a red blocks nothing.

**Task.**
1. Measure both specs' stability: the last ≥ 10 nightly readings, or ≥ 10 local runs on the workspace backend (`ui/e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`).
2. Promote what passes the rule into `test:e2e:live:ci`: 3/3 consecutive green, plus a 5/5 run of the enlarged allowlist. Leave a test that does not pass in nightly, with the reason in its header.
3. Add one assertion each spec lacks, if it is cheap: after a save, re-read the item through `/meta` and assert what was stored (the save round trip, not only the UI state).
4. Stay inside #27550's 2-minute budget. If both do not fit, promote the higher-yield one (designer F4 / F1) and record the choice.

**Reader who acts.** The `domain:ui` seat.

**Dedupe.** The same search as #27550. **New.**
